signal: BLAZE transitioned to an AI-first cannabis retail technology company in October 2025, launching BLAZE Labs, the Herbie AI Budtender, and the Lighthouse AI dashboard

email.body1:
Ryan, saw BLAZE go AI-first with BLAZE Labs and the Herbie and Lighthouse launches.

A pivot that bold usually spikes interest from dispensaries faster than a sales team can cover before it cools, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for BLAZE off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ryan, quick follow-up for BLAZE.

An AI-first relaunch tends to lift demand faster than headcount can absorb, especially heading into rescheduling. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to convert that into the number, so the gap surfaces late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings BLAZE needs across dispensary accounts this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ryan, last bit of proof for BLAZE.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how BLAZE's reply rate likely compares to other vertical SaaS companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ryan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. An AI-first relaunch keeps everyone busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a cannabis retail motion? I'll tailor it to BLAZE either way.
